task.description: WF-02 Step 2c -- security gate on REQ-369's frontend diff (git diff main...HEAD) against docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md INV-1..INV-9.

result.summary:
Scope test: diff is frontend-only (web/src/pages/dashboard/PlatformDashboardPage.tsx new, web/src/router.tsx +2 lines, web/src/pages/OidcCallbackPage.tsx one-line role-conditional navigate(), plus a UAT fixture YAML). No migration, no Ecto schema, no new/changed API route, no secret-resolving code. It does touch role-based routing/gating (PLATFORM_ADMIN) and displays a tenant-count aggregate, so per the dispatch instruction it was treated as plausibly in-scope and checked for real against every invariant rather than reflexively marked NOT-APPLICABLE.

INV-1 (tenant data isolation) -- NOT-APPLICABLE. No Ecto schema module or migration touched by this diff; nothing to check against 0003's :prefix mechanism.

INV-2 (server-side field authorisation) -- APPLIES (this diff introduces a UI surface that is client-side-gated on PLATFORM_ADMIN and fetches a tenant aggregate; verified the actual authorization boundary rather than assuming NOT-APPLICABLE from the invariant doc's stale 'S4 not started' note -- S4's API surface demonstrably exists, e.g. lib/letflow/routers/tenants.ex). Verified: PlatformDashboardPage.tsx's isPlatformAdmin check (Boolean(session?.roles.includes('PLATFORM_ADMIN'))) is UX-only -- it is NOT the security boundary for the tenant data it displays. The underlying call, tenantsApi.list() -> GET /api/v1/tenants, is unchanged by this diff and is enforced server-side by lib/letflow/routers/tenants.ex's `authz_get "/", :TenantsManage` (Letflow.Api.Authorization.evaluate_access/2, PLATFORM_ADMIN-only via the :TenantsManage policy key), checked before any Repo call. Field selection for the response is server-built via the hand-written tenant_map/1 allowlist (6 keys), never a client-side redaction of a fuller struct. So even a non-admin who navigates directly to /platform-dashboard (bypassing the client-side Navigate-away) gets a 403 from the server on the underlying fetch, not a client-side-only block. PASS.

INV-3 (untrusted runtime sandboxing) -- NOT-APPLICABLE. S5 not started; no scripting/plugin code in this diff.

INV-4 (secrets by reference only) -- NOT-APPLICABLE to this diff's content (no config/env/secret-resolving code touched), verified anyway: `grep -rniE "(password|secret|client_secret|token)\s*(=|:)\s*\"[^\"]{8,}\"" web/src/pages/dashboard/PlatformDashboardPage.tsx web/src/router.tsx web/src/pages/OidcCallbackPage.tsx` -- zero hits.

INV-5 (not-found/forbidden indistinguishability) -- NOT-APPLICABLE. This diff adds a dashboard page and a role-conditional redirect, not a new lookup-by-ID endpoint.

INV-6 (new data-access paths prove their scoping) -- APPLIES (meta-invariant, always applies). Satisfied by this handoff itself: PASS status, every invariant explicitly assessed with applies/not-applicable and reasoning.

INV-7 (no SQL string interpolation) -- NOT-APPLICABLE. No SQL/Ecto code in this diff (TypeScript/frontend only).

INV-8 (no unhandled crashes on realistic failure paths) -- NOT-APPLICABLE. Invariant is scoped to lib/letflow/ (Elixir); this diff touches no Elixir code. (Noting for completeness, not as a substitute check: PlatformDashboardPage.tsx's own loading/error/success states are handled via QueryStateBoundary/classifyError, consistent with the project's existing frontend error-handling pattern, but this is outside INV-8's literal scope.)

INV-9 (tenant-controlled outbound URL validation) -- NOT-APPLICABLE. No outbound HTTP request construction from tenant-controlled input in this diff.

No FAIL on any applicable invariant (INV-2, INV-6 both PASS). Routing to REVIEWER per WF-02 Step 2d.
